subject: Handoff: EchoHealth – launch preflight & primary steward
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: EchoHealth – launch preflight & primary steward

Team,

Quick handoff for EchoHealth (deal: DEAL-8372, $375k ARR). Signed PO in-hand; customer expects a production-ready launch on 2026-08-30. Key context below — please read prior to the kickoff so we can avoid last-minute blockers.

One-line summary
- Customer: EchoHealth (mid-sized payer tech company)
- Deployment: Private (VPC peering) with on-prem data connector for PHI ingestion
- SLA expectation: <150ms p99 for conversational endpoints; daily batch embeddings for search
- Primary success metrics: 90% accuracy on clinical intent classification eval, <2% token-cost overrun

Important constraints
- SOC 2 + HITRUST questionnaire in progress; security team expects network diagram + list of approved cipher suites for the on-prem connector.
- EchoHealth's security requires our runtime to be deployed in their AWS account with limited cross-account roles.
- Data retention: 30 days for raw request logs, 12 months for aggregated metrics (they may request longer in procurement).

External contacts
- Arianna Lopez (Project Lead) — arianna.lopez@echohealth.com
- EchoHealth DevOps alias — devops@echohealth.com

Attachments included: echohealth-sow-v3.pdf (SOW with milestones), network-diagram.png (customer network sketch)

Asks for CS (Marissa / Vanessa / Monica)
1) Confirm primary steward and backup
2) Draft a 30/60/90 launch plan and a kickoff agenda by EOD Monday
3) Identify any infra prerequisites that require sales/procurement support (eg. cross-account roles, KMS access)
4) Propose two 1-hour kickoff windows next week (preferably mornings PST)

I'll leave initial pricing and procurement details to Karthik but will coordinate the DocuSign envelope. Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: EchoHealth – launch preflight & primary steward

Thanks for the overview, Jonas — got it.

A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock the steward:
- On the KMS/HSM front: do they require us to use their KMS keys or will they allow a customer-managed key in our account? This affects the Private deployment variant.
- For the on-prem connector: do they expect a persistent VPN or ephemeral transfer? The network diagram hints at a site-to-site VPN but I want to confirm.

I can draft the 30/60/90 and kickoff agenda — will aim to have a first pass by Monday morning.

Prelim note on owners: I can act as program lead for the kickoff and stewardship if Vanessa prefers to allocate a dedicated steward (recommended). If we go with a dedicated steward, Monica Patel is available the week of 7/26 and has run two similar VPC peering launches.

On attachments: please include the latest pricing summary when you have a moment (we'll need it for resource allocation).

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: EchoHealth – launch preflight & primary steward

Marissa — answering your questions inline below and attaching the pricing summary.

- KMS: EchoHealth's security team prefers keys in their AWS account (customer-managed). Procurement flagged this as non-negotiable for PHI.
- On-prem connector: site-to-site VPN, persistent. They run their own firewall and asked for specific IP ranges (see network-diagram.png).

Procurement timeline: Arianna indicated legal expects to finish reviewing the SOW by 7/23; procurement aims to complete wiring and signatures by 7/28. Karthik — please confirm whether we should hold a partial resource reservation in Dedicated while legal finishes (we may need a brief reservation to guarantee slot).

Attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx (price breakdown and recommended reserved pool sizing)

Jonas

Subject: Re: Handoff: EchoHealth – launch preflight & primary steward

Thanks, Jonas — great summary.

Assigning primary steward: Monica Patel will be primary steward for EchoHealth. Monica has availability for kickoff on 7/27 and 7/28 mornings PST; she'll own the 30/60/90 deliverables and the runbook.

Initial next steps (Monica)
- Confirm network IP allowlist with EchoHealth DevOps and validate the site-to-site VPN requirements (deliverable: network checklist) — due 7/23
- Provide a concrete list of IAM/KMS steps for secure cross-account deployment (deliverable: infra runbook) — due 7/26
- Draft kickoff agenda + invite EchoHealth to a 60-min kickoff (options: Tue 7/27 9am PST or Wed 7/28 10am PST) — due EOD 7/20

Karthik: please provision an initial Dedicated reservation for the week of 8/23 (we can scale down if procurement slips). I'll flag this as an ops risk in the activation tracker.

Jonas: please send the DocuSign to Arianna by EOD Monday and confirm when it's out.

Monica — thanks in advance; loop me in on the kickoff invite and any security questions that need escalation.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
